verdict.rationale: Stripe Terminal documents an API-based, server-driven integration alongside its SDKs, and covers reader registration, locations and zones, receipts data and refunds through the Stripe API. Stripe also publishes an OpenAPI specification. A community developer independently praised the ability to fully integrate with the API at the terminal level. missing for 10: Terminal-specific API reference detail (endpoint-level docs for reader actions) is not excerpted in the pack, and no machine-readable OpenAPI was found at standard docs-domain paths (only the GitHub repo).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: Terminal supports an API-based integration in addition to SDKs for Android, iOS, JavaScript, and React Native.
Stripe Terminal SDKs and server-driven integration come with a built-in simulated card reader, so you can develop and test your app without connecting to physical hardware.
You can issue refunds by using the Refunds API or the Dashboard.
This repository contains OpenAPI specifications for Stripe's API.
the ability to fully integrate with the API on a terminal level is the most powerful thing here
